decisions.text: type waterfall: the parts mix positive and negative values and running subtotals are the message: a waterfall, each bar starting where the last ended (G1.38)
the steps in the process's own order, as given; a waterfall is never sorted (D-43)

each step a bar from the running total before it to the one after it: rises Product sales, Consulting income, falls Cost of goods, Admin expenses, the rises in slot 1 and the falls in slot 2 (G7.33: green and red only for a good/bad reading); Net income full bars from zero in the reserved grey (G4.15), each equal to the running total there (G7.33)
digits hidden: millions, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$8 million (net income)”
wrapped onto two lines: Product sales, Consulting income, Cost of goods, Admin expenses, Net income
the unit phrase on the top label: “$8 million (net income)”; the top gridline starts after it
a hairline connector at each running total, from one bar to the next (s. 0237)

source.shows: running subtotals of gains and costs: a waterfall, each step from the running total before it, in the income statement's order, the net income a full grey bar from zero, a hairline connector at each running total (R7-11, G1.38, G7.33, D-43); rises and falls in two colours since no good or bad reading is given, blue and orange
